item.title: Top 10 Methods to Show Distinct Column Values in PySpark DataFrame
item.description:
In the realm of big data analysis, exploring unique values from a column in a PySpark DataFrame is a common task. If you’re coming from a Pandas background, it might be challenging to find equivalent methods in PySpark to get distinct values without resorting to SQL queries or using groupby. Here’s a comprehensive guide to tackle this challenge using various methods.

Exploring Unique Values in a PySpark DataFrame

Let’s dive into a few practical approaches to extract distinct column values from a PySpark DataFrame. We will consider a sample data representation to illustrate these methods effectively.
